lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for adoption redesigns, finish changes (layout, new screen, redesign), sign-in incentives, sign-in notifications, and sign-in reordering (1 test each).
Home wait_info changes are helpful, supported by 2 winning tests out of 3.
Choose_path redesigns and choose_path copy updates showed no positive effect across 2 tests each, ranging from neutral to worse.
Adoption hints, home redesigns, and sign-in copy updates showed no clear effect across 2 tests each.
Predictions were consistently too low for winning changes and too high for changes that showed no clear effect or performed worse.

candidates.title: Existing Account Restore Selection Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated account restore entry screen before sign-in to help returning users find existing pets and avoid accidental resets.
candidates.why: Support mail highlights 8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign_in conversion is 72.9%.

new_account_restore.headline: Returning to Your Pet?
new_account_restore.body: If you already adopted a pet on another device, restore your account here.

guard.reason: screen 'new_account_restore' is not part of onboarding (new screens are named new_..., and may not look like payment, account, sign-up or settings screens)

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Interactive Stamp Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen into a stage layout with an interactive sign and stamp component.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 69.8% with median time of 89s / mean 1017s, showing user friction before finalizing adoption.

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.replace.certificate[1]': a button cannot do the certificate job (use ['animation', 'badge', 'image', 'preview', 'text'])

candidates.title: Background Pet Preparation Sound and Notification Display
candidates.change: Adds audio cues and desktop readiness notifications to notify users when pet generation completes in the background.
candidates.why: Home preparation wait time has median 201s / mean 2336s, and previous wait_info changes were supported by 2 winning tests.

components.text: An audio chime will sound when your pet is ready.

guard.reason: Adds background audio chime and readiness notification settings to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long home wait time with system notifications and audio, requiring OS integration and a app update.

candidates.title: Home Intro Companion Carousel Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the finish screen into an interactive companion carousel illustrating desktop controls and behaviors.
candidates.why: Support received multiple complaints about unclear pet controls (3 emails) and desktop feature misbehavior after setup (4 emails).

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0]': a tip_carousel cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

candidates.title: Pet Preparation Estimated Time Checklist Counter
candidates.change: Displays real-time step progress and estimated remaining creation time on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Waiting step mean time reaches 2336s; wait_info changes have strong positive evidence from 2 winning tests.

waiting.headline: Pet Crafting Progress
waiting.body: Generating pet artwork and desktop behaviors...

guard.reason: Shows real progress and estimated waiting time on the waiting screen during pet creation.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info improvements have 2 winning tests out of 3, backed by severe home wait times.

candidates.title: Sign-In Missing Pet Recovery Notification Banner
candidates.change: Adds a recovery status badge on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users their pet data is safe.
candidates.why: Addresses 8 support tickets from users reporting lost or reset pets after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Desktop Pet
sign_in.hint: Log in to retrieve your existing pets and settings.

guard.reason: Adds a pet recovery status badge on the sign-in screen without introducing dark patterns.

candidates.score_note: Both support tickets (8) and sign-in dropoff point here, but previous sign-in notification test yielded -0.7%.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Character Personality Preview Hint
candidates.change: Adds interactive personality preview hints beneath friend cards during selection.
candidates.why: Adoption stage takes median 89s and mean 1017s, indicating decision paralysis while selecting pets.

pick_friend.hint: Hover over any companion to preview desktop idle animations.

components.text: Each companion features unique idle routines.

guard.reason: Adds character personality preview hints to the pick friend screen.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high dropoff (30.2%), but adoption hints consistently failed in prior tests (-3.0%).

candidates.title: Desktop Control Hotkeys Guide Hint
candidates.change: Displays desktop shortcut keys and system tray control hints on the finish screen.
candidates.why: Support tickets highlight user confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet post-onboarding.

home_intro.hint: Right-click your pet or click the system tray icon to control or hide.

components.text: Hotkey: Press Alt+P to summon or dismiss your pet anytime.

guard.reason: Adds desktop control hotkey guide hints to the home intro screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses support complaints about post-onboarding hotkeys with simple UI guide config on finish screen.

candidates.title: Onboarding Progression Gift Badge Display
candidates.change: Adds a reward badge on the story screen showing users they will earn a starter accessory upon completion.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion is only 28.5%, so early task completion motivation is critical.

story.headline: Welcome to Desktop Pets
story.body: Complete onboarding to receive a free starter desktop accessory.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions a free starter accessory, which violates the pricing copy restrictions.

candidates.title: Cloud Sync Pet Safeguard Incentive Badge
candidates.change: Adds a cloud backup safeguard incentive badge on the sign-in screen to emphasize data safety.
candidates.why: Directly targets the top support theme (8 emails) regarding pets missing or reset after re-login.

sign_in.body: Signing in secures your pet state in cloud backup so your companion is never reset.

guard.reason: Adds a cloud sync safeguard badge on the sign-in screen without violating pricing or fair design rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong dual evidence from support tickets and sign-in funnel, but sign-in incentives previously showed -0.7%.

lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for single-test categories: adoption redesigns, finish changes (hint, layout, new screen, redesign), home new_flow, sign-in notifications, and sign-in reordering.
Home wait_info changes are helpful, supported by 2 winning tests out of 3.
Choose_path redesigns and choose_path copy updates showed no positive effect across 2 tests each, ranging from neutral to worse.
Adoption hints (3 tests), home redesigns (2 tests), sign-in copy updates (2 tests), and sign-in incentives (2 tests) showed no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently too low for winning changes and too high for changes that showed no clear effect or performed worse.
